title: 第6章 商谈
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

祁澜和自家二郎是好友是一码事，其本身邦国世子的身份，又是另外一回事。

“此前一月，我已经带着世子上次送来的琥珀晶糖，拜访便了蜀地内诸多侯伯子男、大夫上士之家，打通了各家渠道，此表已经按照世子的要求，整理了诸家所愿意拿出的交换之物。”

杨天佑直入正题，转头看向杨蛟。

后者冲着祁澜憨厚一笑，从身后搬来一个箩筐，里头放了一堆竹简。

“各家愿出的交换之物、成色、底线，皆录于此。”杨天佑说道。

祁澜接过竹简，飞速地翻看了起来。

自从开发出【灵思巧悟】这个词条后，他的脑力和眼力就有了一定程度的强化，过目不忘，算无遗策肯定算不上，但记忆力和对信息的接收、处理、理解速度都快了许多。

纵是一目十行，也能大解其意，很快就把这半箩筐的竹简的内容给看完了。

杨天佑也不知用了什么方法，这一个月走访了诸多部落，最远甚至到了蜀地另一端邛伯、金沙子的领地。

那儿多有露天的大型铜矿，同时也多有金沙、山间美玉伴生。

而这些矿石，也都在对方给出的交易清单里面。

此外，兽皮、青铜礼器、精制陶器、上等精米、山货、药材，也都有不少，都依照不同的品质、价值给出了大致的交换比例。

有额外要求的也有，比如说有几个诸侯就意识到了这琥珀晶糖的前景，希望拿下代售权，在自家领地，或是周边领地成为唯一销售方，而给出的条件，也都还算丰厚。

这自然不可能是那些诸侯心肠好，人傻钱多，肯定是杨天佑本人在这其中出了力周旋游说的。

这人比起那些神仙大能之辈自是差得远了，但在凡人之中，却也算颇有才能的杰出之辈。

当然，这其中自然也免不了人家神仙老婆的调教。

但可惜成也萧何，败也萧何，正是因为这人的老婆是天帝妹子，祁澜对他的利用，就必须慎重。

杨家几个孩子身上有天帝血脉，还有几分可能过了这一劫，但等事发的那一天，他杨天佑绝对是魂飞魄散，死无葬身之地的下场。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It's one thing for Qi Lan to be friends with Erlang, but it's another thing for him to be the heir apparent of his own country.

"In the previous month, I took the amber crystal candy that the prince sent last time to visit the homes of many uncles, officials and sergeants in Shu. I opened up channels for each family. Now, in accordance with the prince's request, I have sorted out the things that the families are willing to give in exchange."

Yang Tianyou went straight to the point and turned to look at Yang Jiao.

The latter smiled honestly at Qi Lan and brought a basket from behind with a pile of bamboo slips in it.

"The exchange items, quality, and bottom line that each family is willing to give are all recorded here." Yang Tianyou said.

Qi Lan took the bamboo slips and read them quickly.

Since developing the entry [Ingenuity and Enlightenment], his brainpower and eyesight have been strengthened to a certain extent. His photographic memory is definitely not exhaustive, but his memory and the speed of receiving, processing, and understanding information have been much faster.

Even with just one glance and ten lines, I could understand its meaning, and I quickly finished reading the contents of half a basket of bamboo slips.

Yang Tianyou didn't know what method he used. He visited many tribes this month, and even reached the territory of Qiong Bo and Jinsha at the other end of Shu.

There are many large-scale open-pit copper mines there, and there are also many golden sands and beautiful jade in the mountains.

And these ores are also in the transaction list given by the other party.

In addition, there are many animal skins, bronze ritual vessels, refined pottery, high-quality polished rice, mountain products, and medicinal materials, and rough exchange ratios are given according to different qualities and values.

There are also some who have additional requirements. For example, several princes have realized the prospects of this amber crystal candy and hope to win the sales agency rights and become the sole seller in their own territory or surrounding territories, and the conditions given are quite generous.

Naturally, it cannot be that those princes are kind-hearted and stupid and have a lot of money. It must be Yang Tianyou himself who played a hard role in lobbying.

This person is far behind those immortals and powerful people, but among mortals, he is still considered a talented and outstanding person.

Of course, the training of his fairy wife is inevitable.

But it's a pity that Xiao He will succeed and Xiao He will fail. It is precisely because this man's wife is the sister of the Emperor of Heaven, so Qi Lan must be careful when using him.

Several children of the Yang family have the blood of the Emperor of Heaven, and there is a possibility that they will survive this disaster, but on the day of the incident, Yang Tianyou will definitely be in disgrace and die without a burial place.
